records.text: I'm especially grateful for Beekeepers Naturals' amazing propolis throat spray. If you haven't heard of propolis, it's this natural immune-supporting substance that bees make to protect their hives. It's like nature's own shield, packed with antioxidants and over 300 beneficial compounds.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
